commit.message:
Add a Windows MXC sandbox opt-out (#51547)

## What changed

Add `windows.allow_mxc` to configuration and its JSON schema. Setting it to `false` blocks automatic MXC selection even when `features.prefer_mxc` is enabled, and rejects explicit `windows.sandbox = "mxc"` configuration with a clear error. Omitting the setting preserves existing behavior.

## Testing

Extend configuration tests to cover disabling automatic MXC selection and rejecting explicit MXC configuration when `windows.allow_mxc = false`.

GitOrigin-RevId: bf7c0648cfcb3cc1d0dc41b9faffcb8078672780

Add completion-aware realtime attachment and session-scoped detach (#51539)

## Why

A delayed detach or cleanup from an older realtime conversation must not close its replacement or end the replacement's history segment. Realtime start parameters can also contain credentials in text and transport endpoints, so diagnostics should avoid exposing them.

## What changed

- Add `RealtimeConversationAttach` to report the connection attempt's result through a reply channel, using the sequential start path.
- Add `RealtimeConversationDetach` to close only the matching `realtime_session_id` after earlier starts finish. Detaching an older session leaves the replacement connected.
- Emit the previous conversation's close event before starting its replacement, and prevent stale fanout cleanup from closing or clearing the replacement's context.
- Limit `ConversationStartParams` debug output to output modality, initial item count, and protocol version.

## Testing

Add coverage for attachment completion after the handshake, stale detaches, failed replacement and retry, natural-close ordering, handoff history after replacement, and debug redaction for existing-call and WebRTC transports.

GitOrigin-RevId: 23aee6f70522f0b17e6aa9349dbbcc2ea985f233

Ignore ripgrep configuration when expanding sandbox deny globs (#51527)

## Why

User ripgrep configuration can suppress the file list used to construct Linux sandbox deny masks. For example, `--quiet` in `RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH` can leave files matching deny globs unmasked.

## What changed

Pass `--no-config` to the ripgrep invocation that expands denied-file globs.

## Testing

Extend the multiple-denied-files regression test with a ripgrep configuration containing `--quiet`, checking that denied files remain unreadable and unwritable while allowed files remain accessible. Skip the ripgrep-specific case when no protected `rg` executable is available.

GitOrigin-RevId: 06a6e27e0edec92e79e99af5144b57f86079953f

Preserve the CLI MXC preference in executor config reads (#51525)

## Why

Executor config reads omitted the startup `features.prefer_mxc` override, so clients could not see the CLI sandbox preference.

## What changed

- Include the explicit CLI `features.prefer_mxc` value in `environmentConfig/read` as a `session-flags` layer, above project config and below legacy managed file and MDM config.
- Retain only this preference from startup overrides.
- Expose `windows_mxc_allowed_by_config` to share MXC eligibility checks after callers resolve the active permission profile.

## Testing

Add CLI and remote executor coverage for preference propagation and filtering, plus a unit test verifying that both legacy managed config sources retain precedence.

GitOrigin-RevId: 5ac6f5257f1e807c2f197dcf5dcb2385cedca0ea

Pass thread persistence intent to attachment uploads (#51517)

## Why

Attachment stores need to distinguish uploads from ephemeral threads, which intentionally skip durable persistence.

## What changed

Add `ephemeral` to `UploadRequest` and propagate the turn configuration through image preparation for messages, tool outputs, and history replay. Include the flag in debug output while keeping attachment bytes redacted.

## Testing

Extend the Guardian context-budget test to assert that a persistent Guardian uploads exactly one image with `ephemeral: false`. Update the attachment debug-output assertion to include the new field.

GitOrigin-RevId: 42814c514a571ed6798e4dcf79a22028ee4efc28

Expose detailed agent tree shutdown failure reports (#51515)

## Why

Agent tree shutdown previously returned a generic error without identifying which operation or thread failed, making cleanup failures difficult to diagnose.

## What changed

- Add `AgentTreeShutdown::wait_detailed()` and public report types while preserving the existing `wait()` result and error message.
- Record operation, optional thread ID, and either an abandoned teardown guard or a failed phase with a payload-free error category across session cleanup, child spawn cleanup, and resident eviction.
- Give each tree a correlation ID, log each failure, and retain up to 64 failures with a count of additional failures omitted. Record failures before releasing tree membership so all completed waiters observe the same report.

## Testing

Add unit coverage for aborted and completed teardown, cloned guard context, concurrent and repeated waiters, omitted failure counts, and report formatting without raw error payloads. Extend integration coverage for successful tree shutdown and persistence writer failures, including compatibility with `wait()`.

GitOrigin-RevId: 68784af28b63e875b00a55d78729f0cc5b01ac15

Align Windows sandbox temp permissions with the child environment (#51512)

## Why

Windows temp grants could fall back to host `TEMP`/`TMP` values and bypass read-only or denied subpaths. Sandbox permissions must match the environment passed to the child process.

## What changed

- Resolve `:tmpdir` from absolute `TEMP`/`TMP` paths in the completed workload environment, preserving access modes and missing-path rules without falling back to host values.
- Deduplicate Windows environment keys case-insensitively in a deterministic order so permission resolution and the child environment select the same value.
- Use the resolved temp policy for elevated sandbox overrides across core execution, exec-server, and direct spawning.
- Launch direct-spawn sandbox wrappers with the supplied Codex executable, materializing an inner helper only when it is that executable.

## Testing

Add Windows regression coverage for temp-only writes, read-only and denied carveouts, mixed-case and duplicate environment keys, unavailable temp paths, and empty or missing write-root overrides. Exercise core execution and direct spawning, and extend exec-server RPC coverage to the elevated backend with temp values set through the environment policy.

GitOrigin-RevId: 16b8bd4702cc434fd743a08c75a3e4515780bff3

Fix Windows 10 drive-letter opens for no-follow filesystem operations (#51511)

## Why

On Windows 10, strict native opens can reject the DOS drive alias itself as a reparse point, preventing no-follow filesystem operations on ordinary drive-letter paths.

## What changed

Retry rejected drive-letter opens relative to a verified local volume root. Require the root to resolve to a physical disk volume directory without reparse attributes, and retain `OBJ_DONT_REPARSE` for paths beneath it so junctions remain blocked.

## Testing

Add Windows tests for file creation and reading through the volume fallback, opening the drive root, and rejecting junction traversal and creation. Validate accepted volume-root names and verify that named pipes are rejected without establishing a client connection.

GitOrigin-RevId: 51ffde4f77d2af45d18dfc4cb026d73a0e69b061

Preserve live TUI settings when configuration reloads fail (#51510)

## Why

Live preferences can be newer than the last successful configuration load. Starting a new thread after a reload failure could overwrite those preferences with stale settings.

## What changed

Carry local settings alongside the new-session configuration, retaining the live settings when reloading fails and applying the staged settings when the new thread starts. During resume and agent selection, replace staged local settings only when the directory-trust check actually reloads configuration.

## Testing

Add a regression test that changes a live rendering preference, writes invalid `config.toml`, and verifies that loading a new thread's configuration preserves the live local settings.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4ac3c70de6d627e1609cc0a5d4ba5df5a61a8b20

Expose selected environments to MCP contributors (#51503)

## Why

MCP contributors need the complete executor selection to distinguish an unavailable primary executor from a ready secondary. Ready capability roots alone do not preserve pending or failed selections.

## What changed

Add `with_selected_environments` and `selected_environments` to `McpServerContributionContext`, and pass the captured selections during thread MCP resolution and model-step plugin selection. Preserve priority order and pending or failed entries. Use `None` for threadless discovery and `Some(&[])` for an explicitly empty selection.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for executor ordering with pending and failed selections, environment context in model-step plugin selection, and the distinction between absent and explicitly empty selections.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2c1222fae72c7e2c75b2f40abfad3b2048cf9316

Bound relay connection attempts and handle pongs during blocked writes (#51502)

## Why

A stalled rendezvous WebSocket upgrade can prevent reconnects, while short-lived connections reset reconnect backoff too early. Blocked relay writes also prevent received pongs from clearing their heartbeat deadline.

## What changed

- Bound rendezvous WebSocket connection attempts with `DEFAULT_REMOTE_EXEC_SERVER_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`.
- Retain exponential reconnect backoff across short-lived connections, resetting it only after a connection lasts at least 120 seconds.
- Process pongs during blocked data writes while preserving the in-flight send and its independent write timeout. Prefer queued pongs over an expired heartbeat deadline.
- Abort the relay writer when its owning connection task is dropped.

## Testing

Add coverage for pongs arriving during blocked writes, missing and queued pongs, independent write timeouts, and writer cancellation. Extend reconnect tests to cover stalled WebSocket upgrades without re-registration and backoff reset after a stable session.

GitOrigin-RevId: 0efa350c2b4ada9b89e23df8909063fbb69f33dc

Add shared task pinning to the agent command center (#51500)

## What changed

- Use `p` to pin or unpin the selected task, with a configurable `agents.toggle_pin` binding.
- Display pinned tasks first in a `Pinned` group, preserving shared section order and applying search and status filters.
- Load pins from the shared thread section, including tasks outside the recent-task window, and refresh after pin changes. Disable pinning when the server does not support shared sections.

## Testing

Add coverage for shared pin/unpin state, paginated pin discovery and refreshing pins on reopen, shortcut dispatch and duplicate-action suppression, and pinned-group and custom-help snapshots.

GitOrigin-RevId: d1a2cab6642d059c3c8df8480b5c59a10c493936

Load rollout history on a single blocking worker (#51499)

## What changed

Move full rollout history reading and parsing into one blocking worker for both plain `.jsonl` and compressed `.jsonl.zst` files. Use the shared cancellation-aware line iterator so canceled loads stop before processing another record, while preserving rollout items, thread IDs, and parse-error counts.

## Testing

Add regression tests for cancellation between records and equivalent history-loading results across plain and compressed files, including Unicode, CRLF line endings, malformed records, empty files, and invalid UTF-8.

GitOrigin-RevId: 65e1bd7ebcdbbd0ab5f560e73b2c7f074f627f8f

Bind capability roots to environment selections (#51493)

## Why

Capability discovery needs the roots captured with each environment snapshot. Threads sharing an executor can select different roots, and changing environment order must preserve executor skill aliases.

## What changed

- Attach the receiving thread's capability roots when constructing `TurnEnvironmentSelection` at startup and settings updates, including roots loaded from saved history.
- Resolve capability roots from environment snapshots while preserving their original order. Retain startup roots so deselecting and reselecting an environment restores its capabilities.
- Match inherited configuration by environment and workspace so differences in capability root metadata do not interrupt configuration propagation.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for root ordering across environment states and configuration changes, independent root selections on a shared executor, reselection with startup or saved roots, active turn updates, and pending configuration failures reaching child and grandchild threads.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4f2e4bb414d27195a6752406117a6050718a1198

Remove obsolete fields from persisted turn context (#51492)

## What changed

Remove `workspace_roots`, `current_date`, `timezone`, `network`, `personality`, and `multi_agent_mode` from `TurnContextItem` and stop recording them in rollouts. Update the precomputed protocol schema accordingly.

Make `summary` optional when reading turn context and write `"none"` as a compatibility placeholder for older readers, rather than persisting the active reasoning-summary setting.

## Testing

Update protocol tests to cover omitted `summary` fields and compatibility-placeholder serialization. Extend compaction tests to verify that model requests retain the updated reasoning-summary setting after compaction while the rollout checkpoint records the placeholder.

GitOrigin-RevId: d49eabaa1b340be1d79f7f09115281a307ea8a64

Classify executor capability root ownership independently of parsing (#51491)

## Why

A malformed plugin manifest still marks a capability root as plugin-owned. Discovery or metadata failures must not be treated as evidence that a root is standalone.

## What changed

- Add `ExecutorPluginProvider::root_ownership` and export `PluginRootOwnership` to distinguish plugin-owned roots from standalone roots before capability parsing.
- Use discovery results when conclusive; otherwise probe manifest files at the selected root and its ancestors using the supplied filesystem sandbox. Nested plugin manifests do not establish ownership of their parent root.
- Share manifest lookup with plugin resolution and pipeline up to 256 metadata probes while preserving ancestor and manifest priority, including error ordering.

## Testing

Add tests for malformed ancestor manifests, discovery failures, ancestor versus nested ownership, concurrent probe ordering, and sandboxed metadata checks without reading manifest contents.

GitOrigin-RevId: 3512452cf1df22f52c2a2b422f96c760d98c24ac

Add correlated, credential-free rendezvous connection diagnostics (#51483)

## Why

Rendezvous connection warnings report only a generic WebSocket error, while debug logs include raw error text. Structured diagnostics make failures easier to investigate without logging potentially sensitive error payloads.

## What changed

- Generate a request ID for each connection attempt, send it as `x-request-id`, and include it in the connection span and connection, disconnection, and failure logs alongside the attempt count.
- Replace raw error logging with typed error categories, I/O error kinds, HTTP status codes, and allowlisted values from `x-codex-rendezvous-rejection-reason`.
- Ignore unknown rejection reasons and response bodies.

## Testing

Add tests for rejection-header allowlisting, typed I/O failures, and a rejected WebSocket handshake that verifies the request ID header and preserves the HTTP status and known rejection reason.

GitOrigin-RevId: a8274fec965bcf5b8453b047c0bb79396cdf6ba4

Use PathUri for skill identity and path matching (#51482)

## Why

Skill selection and disabled-path matching need to recognize equivalent Windows paths across case and separator differences while preserving literal spaces, `%`, and `#` in native filenames.

## What changed

- Carry `PathUri` through skill metadata, discovery mappings, filesystem lookups, disabled-path sets, and invocation analytics.
- Match linked skill mentions and TUI selections by parsed path identity.
- Use `LegacyAppPathString` for app-server skill paths and regenerate schemas and SDK types, preserving native path strings on the wire.
- Preserve native catalog display paths and ordering. Keep host filesystem probes and configuration writes restricted to host-compatible paths.

## Testing

Add regression tests for Windows path identity and disabled-skill matching, literal filename characters, catalog resource reads, native path ordering, and foreign-path analytics normalization.

GitOrigin-RevId: c212916dc9fef0e7616542726e107f0d6a313267

Preserve tool declaration mode across resumed context windows (#51480)

## Why

Changing the incremental tools setting on resume should not move tool declarations and base instructions within an existing context window.

## What changed

- Determine the current window's tool declaration mode from its history, and apply the incremental tools setting when building a new window after compaction or a context reset.
- Use that mode consistently for sampling, remote compaction, startup prewarm, prompt debugging, and Guardian input budgeting.
- Preserve tool declarations alongside their comparison baseline in full-history agent forks, including compacted histories; remove them together when rebuilding context.

## Testing

Add request snapshots covering legacy resume, migration after remote compaction or a context reset, disabling incremental tools, and tool updates after restart. Extend agent fork and WebSocket startup prewarm tests to cover retained declarations and incremental tools.

GitOrigin-RevId: 7c46849a1788027a8435082e4d1f7e7f48d2700c

Preserve URL destinations in wrapped hook details (#51473)

## Why

The hooks browser rendered detail URLs as plain text. Long URLs in hook commands can wrap or be truncated, so their visible text may omit part of the destination.

## What changed

Render web URLs in hook details as terminal hyperlinks, preserving the complete destination across wrapped lines and truncated text. Keep truncation ellipses outside the links.

## Testing

Add a regression test and snapshot for a wrapped, truncated hook command URL, checking that linked cells retain the complete destination and the ellipsis remains unlinked.

GitOrigin-RevId: 488562266bd5ef880c03bf313bc4cfa7d3104c7b

Preserve clickable URLs in TUI selection rows (#51472)

## What changed

Render web URLs in selection labels and descriptions as terminal hyperlinks, preserving their complete destinations when text wraps or is truncated. Carry hyperlink ranges through two-column layouts and keep truncation ellipses outside links.

## Testing

Add regression assertions and a snapshot covering wrapped and single-line rows, prefixed labels, descriptions, and wide Unicode characters. Verify that visible URL fragments retain complete destinations and ellipses are not linked.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9d50b3ced79cbd29200e48a676445ec169d60758

Preserve clickable URLs in pending input previews (#51471)

## What changed

Render web URLs in pending steers, rejected steers, and queued follow-up messages as terminal hyperlinks. Preserve the complete destination when the visible URL is clipped to the preview width.

Add `HyperlinkRows` to render already-wrapped rows without changing their spacing or row count, clipping text and hyperlink ranges to the viewport.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for complete URL destinations across all three preview sections, plus snapshots for oversized URLs and clipping overflow text and the edit hint in a narrow preview.

GitOrigin-RevId: 959df27bba381b1b3895f5a86cc2ecb1419806b1

Raise the managed app-server file descriptor limit on Unix (#51470)

## What changed

For managed app-server daemons using Unix sockets, raise the soft
`RLIMIT_NOFILE` limit to 4096 at startup, capped by the inherited hard limit.
Preserve existing higher soft limits and log a warning if the adjustment fails.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2ef27370e55cd86a7a62cbc3d47041933b89ac21

Keep submission logs useful without exposing payloads (#51467)

## Why

Submission diagnostics need approval and turn metadata without logging user input, tool responses, commands, paths, or instruction payloads.

## What changed

- Log thread and submission IDs, operation kind, and parent/root turn IDs as explicit fields.
- Give `Op` and `ThreadSettingsOverrides` selective `Debug` output that retains identifiers, approval decisions, and policy categories while omitting payloads.
- Preserve Guardian review identifiers and status when logging approval of a denied-action retry.

## Testing

Add an app-server integration test that verifies command approval, Guardian review, and turn policy metadata reach SQLite-backed diagnostic logs with `RUST_LOG=off`.

GitOrigin-RevId: 308acb7b70e4849cf31514b11e4d9b46eaf6a09b

Keep Guardian transcript records structured through budget recovery (#51466)

## What changed

Introduce `TranscriptRecord` and `PreparedTranscript` to retain attributed transcript text through preparation and composition. Cache rendered content, byte counts, and token estimates, refreshing them when text or framing changes.

Keep JSON records structured during budget recovery so truncation replaces only `text`, preserving metadata, field order, and framing without reparsing serialized JSON. Preserve whole-entry truncation for line transcripts and update synchronous and asynchronous consumers to use the preparation API.

## Testing

Expand coverage for cached estimates and delivery with escaped text, Unicode, and large payloads; metadata and framing preservation during recovery; and stable asynchronous history prefixes in both line and JSON formats.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8b3b5231ca4a6ee47d17dcc788ea68c56dd1a9bc

Add an optional JSON transcript format for Guardian (#51465)

## Why

Transcript content can contain forged role headers, transcript boundaries, or claims of user approval. Guardian needs to distinguish that content from host-assigned authorship metadata.

## What changed

- Add `features.guardianv2.transcript_mode` with `line` (the default) and `json` options for synchronous review and asynchronous scoring.
- Render JSON transcript entries with host-assigned metadata and escaped `text`, and prepend matching provenance instructions to reviewer and classifier prompts.
- Preserve JSON metadata when budget recovery shortens historical text, and keep provenance instructions outside the configured classifier prompt limit.

## Testing

Add coverage for forged roles and approvals remaining within their original entries, JSON metadata surviving budget recovery, and provenance instructions surviving prompt limits. Extend review and scoring integration tests to verify JSON evidence and matching instructions.

GitOrigin-RevId: 81a3580390d3c4d1a664e554976cda5f1adc9a2c

Record resolved model and reasoning effort in sub-agent activity (#51463)

## What changed

Add `model` and `reasoningEffort` to `subAgentActivity` items for multi-agent v2 spawns. Capture startup settings before the child begins its turn and resolve the reported effort against model metadata, including model defaults, while preserving the child's configured effort.

Carry these fields through live notifications, persisted activity, thread history, and legacy rollout migration. Update the JSON schemas and generated TypeScript and Python types. Older records and other activity kinds retain null values.

## Testing

Add coverage for resolved spawn settings matching the child's request across legacy and paginated history, preserving configured effort, forwarding metadata through events and history, and reading and migrating older records without the new fields.

GitOrigin-RevId: a9e4241ae21bb8db1ead293f78ffba8257cca0ae

Retry realtime sideband attachment while an existing call activates (#51460)

## Why

Instant Connect can return a call ID before ICE activates the call, causing sideband attachment to briefly fail with HTTP `404` while the client connects media.

## What changed

Retry `404` responses from `connect_existing_call_sideband` up to three times, waiting 100, 300, and 800 milliseconds. Return the error once this activation retry budget is exhausted, and preserve the existing handling of other errors.

## Testing

Add WebSocket coverage for successful attachment after three `404` responses, failure after four `404` responses, and no retry on HTTP `410`. Verify that successful attachment does not overwrite the prepared session configuration.

GitOrigin-RevId: 5d18ff7eeeb9abd56388808828382f7350c7ae57

Preserve wrapped help links in Windows sandbox prompts (#51459)

## What changed

Render help text in Windows sandbox setup and fallback prompts with `HyperlinkText` so each wrapped URL fragment links to the complete destination. Strip OSC 8 sequences when rendering popup snapshots to keep assertions focused on visible text.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering both prompts at 40 columns, asserting that every linked cell retains the complete destination and the visible link text remains intact. Include a snapshot of the wrapped setup prompt.

GitOrigin-RevId: 98bd60f04ab3ec8d6552a0b74b9637cce26169d5

Make URLs clickable in user verification prompts (#51458)

## What changed

Render user verification titles and request details with `HyperlinkText` so URLs carry terminal hyperlinks, including in the waiting-for-verification view.

## Testing

Extend the narrow-prompt regression test to verify that wrapped URLs retain their full hyperlink targets before and during verification. Strip OSC 8 annotations when comparing visible text in snapshots.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9b2fba963c028eaa2b177220b0487364b44d04bb

Preserve status usage hyperlinks when the URL wraps (#51457)

## Why

The ChatGPT usage URL in the status card loses its terminal hyperlink when it wraps across lines in a narrow terminal.

## What changed

Attach the usage URL destination to each underlined span so every wrapped fragment remains clickable.

## Testing

Extend status hyperlink coverage at widths of 24, 42, and 120 columns to verify that linked fragments reconstruct the full URL and all point to the same destination.

GitOrigin-RevId: 516421380763f48da8af63b4d374e2b352722ddb

Make banner URLs clickable across wrapped lines (#51452)

## What changed

Render URLs in TUI banner titles and descriptions as terminal hyperlinks, preserving the full destination when a URL wraps across lines.

## Testing

Add a regression test that checks hyperlink destinations for a wrapped URL and snapshots the visible banner layout.

GitOrigin-RevId: 1b1957570c1c0940a60f5a202648b0eeed5b95e1

Make URLs in the TUI warnings viewer clickable (#51451)

## What changed

Render web URLs in warning details as terminal hyperlinks, preserving the full destination when a URL wraps across lines or the viewer scrolls.

## Testing

Add a regression test for hyperlink destinations after wrapping and scrolling, plus a snapshot of a warning containing a wrapped URL.

GitOrigin-RevId: 6500e6129a95b2dea8e8f53296ca056e63196a57

Make URLs clickable in MCP elicitation prompts (#51450)

## What changed

Render web URLs in TUI MCP elicitation prompts as terminal hyperlinks. Preserve the full destination when a URL wraps across lines, while retaining the existing styling for answered and unanswered prompts.

## Testing

Add a regression test that verifies each linked cell of a wrapped URL targets the complete URL, including its query string, and a snapshot of the rendered form.

GitOrigin-RevId: 74baabbee6b72b695e1534d694296a3352f7e47d

Make URLs clickable in TUI user input questions (#51449)

## What changed

Render web URLs in `request_user_input` question text as terminal hyperlinks. Preserve the complete destination when a URL wraps across rows, along with explicit newlines and blank lines in the question.

## Testing

Add a regression test that checks each linked fragment retains the complete URL, including its query string, and snapshots the wrapped question layout.

GitOrigin-RevId: 473c8a8a00797c0b353a9cdb762dea2c718d9190

Fix core integration tests for updated turn APIs (#51441)

Use `TurnEnvironmentRequests` and the executor environment's `request()` in the MCP turn metadata test to match `ThreadSettingsOverrides`. Allow additional fields when matching `TurnInputSubmission::Started` in the pending input test.

GitOrigin-RevId: 6f7f7c60511d999274079f715ba2a68163e69caf

Honor Retry-After in WebSocket error events (#51440)

## Why

WebSocket rate-limit and overload errors ignored `Retry-After` advice and ended turns even when the server supplied a retry delay.

## What changed

Extract retry advice from nested `error.headers`, falling back to top-level `headers` when nested advice is missing or invalid. Use the shared HTTP header validation and retry-delay parser, and preserve the delay when mapping WebSocket errors.

## Testing

Add coverage for nested-header precedence, malformed headers, HTTP header validation, and recovery after an advised rate limit. Verify that overloads retry only while advice is present, without falling back to HTTP, and that headerless rate limits, usage limits, and `flex_unavailable` errors remain terminal.

GitOrigin-RevId: 61add0c36197e10402d6d3c325332aac72a5a521

Preserve clickable URLs in TUI approval headers (#51439)

## What changed

Render command, permission, patch, and MCP elicitation approval headers with `HyperlinkText`, which annotates web URLs and preserves their full destinations across wrapping and clipping.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering wrapped URL destinations in all four header types, plus a snapshot of the wrapped command approval header.

GitOrigin-RevId: 7f6b79484c9297cd03514da2d6805b0d239fee63

Show hook status messages as titles in the hooks browser (#51433)

## What changed

Replace generic `Hook 1` labels with trimmed `status_message` titles, falling back to `Unnamed hook` when the message is missing or blank. Show aligned, dimmed row numbers alongside the titles and retain trust-status suffixes.

Render rows with `Paragraph` to preserve full-row selection styling and per-span dimming, including titles containing wide characters and emoji.

## Testing

Add snapshot and buffer assertions for title trimming, blank and missing messages, wide characters, selection styling, and dimmed indices. Update snapshots for long-title truncation and scrolling across two-digit row numbers.

GitOrigin-RevId: a9b20ea91e7252b6399d1c8a9fa849186f16a651

Prevent invalidated wakeups from starting a turn (#51427)

## Why

An interrupt or turn replacement can invalidate a pending-work wakeup while its turn context is being constructed. Task startup could then recreate a turn whose reservation was no longer active.

## What changed

- Recheck that the wakeup still owns the active turn reservation immediately before calling `start_task`, and return if it does not.
- Allow the remote-control re-enrollment test up to 45 seconds for the connection following reconnect backoff.

## Testing

Add a regression test that pauses wakeup context construction, processes an interrupt, and then resumes construction. It verifies that no additional turn starts and only the initial model request is sent.

GitOrigin-RevId: c857fdd9f0fac3790d35a95a1f21a6d41977bb29

Remove the Bazel JVM override for Windows ARM64 voice builds (#51426)

## What changed

Stop setting `BAZEL_HOST_JVM_ARG=-Xint` in the Windows release workflow and remove support for forwarding `BAZEL_HOST_JVM_ARG` as `--host_jvm_args` in `.github/scripts/run-bazel-ci.sh`.

GitOrigin-RevId: 49ff5a56dc00b14c529ebefab917cb1d68216431

Skip stable installer alias publishing for prereleases (#51425)

## What changed

Require `--prerelease false` before publishing the R2 `codex/install.sh` and `codex/install.ps1` aliases when updating the `latest` channel. This keeps prereleases marked latest from overwriting the stable installer aliases.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2ee7a8aee03f5242fb3b85af377655017e0d23b8

Accept environment requests at thread and turn settings boundaries (#51422)

## What changed

Add `TurnEnvironmentRequests` to carry environment requests together with their fallback working directory. Update thread settings overrides and active turn settings to accept requests, constructing `TurnEnvironmentSelection` values in the receiving thread before validation and runtime use.

Adapt app-server callers, reviewer settings, and existing tests to supply requests or explicitly convert runtime selections back into requests.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8028f804bebe3fde553f57bb450f6dca3970cc4a

Include root turn IDs in host-owned Apps tool calls (#51421)

## What changed

Add the turn's `root_turn_id` to `_codex_apps` request metadata for host-owned Apps MCP calls. Remove any tool-supplied value before populating it from turn metadata, and omit the field for user-configured or extension-owned Apps servers.

## Testing

Extend unit coverage to verify that host-owned Apps calls replace an untrusted `root_turn_id` and user-configured Apps calls omit it. Update integration assertions for default and explicitly supplied root turn IDs, including approval flows, and verify that extension-owned calls omit the field.

GitOrigin-RevId: 754a642c2fff36a866b8cffa9fb3e161f232de08

Finish idle thread unloads after slow shutdown (#51420)

## Why

Idle thread unloading stopped waiting after ten seconds, leaving the thread loaded when resource cleanup took longer.

## What changed

Keep awaiting the same shutdown future after the ten-second deadline, emitting `codex.app_server.thread_shutdown_slow` as a warning. Once shutdown completes, remove the thread and send `thread/closed` without requiring another unload request.

## Testing

Clean up Unix app-server control-socket startup lock files (#51191)

## Why

Unix control-socket shutdown removes the socket and rendezvous link but leaves the startup lock file behind.

## What changed

Keep a removable startup lock with the control-socket guard and release the lock after publishing the rendezvous link. On cleanup, reacquire the lock and verify that the path still identifies the same file before removing it.

Use nonblocking acquisition with asynchronous retries, checking file identity after acquisition to handle lock-file replacement.

## Testing

Add tests for nonblocking lock contention and dangling symlink rejection, and extend the control-socket lifecycle test to verify that the lock file is removed on shutdown.

Record base instructions in incremental tool history (#51188)

## What changed

- Record nonempty base instructions as a developer message after tool declarations at the start of each incremental tool context window, and omit the request-level `instructions` field.
- Preserve this prefix when rebuilding history after local or remote compaction, while keeping the compaction summary last.
- Count recorded base instructions once when estimating context usage and trimming tool outputs.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for instruction placement, omission of request-level instructions, compaction ordering, and token accounting. Exercise remote compaction trimming with both request-level and recorded base instructions.

Prevent stable release pointers from moving backward (#51186)

## Why

Publishing an older stable version should not replace a newer release as the default download or installation target.

## What changed

- Compare stable versions before marking a GitHub release as latest, allowing same-version reruns to finish publication.
- Guard npm `latest` and platform dist-tags, publishing older versions under separate `release-<version>-<tag>` tags.
- Check R2's `latest` channel before updating it or the installer aliases, while allowing same-version reruns to repair interrupted installer updates.
- Reject invalid existing stable release metadata and consolidate GitHub latest and canary checks in `releases.py`.

## Testing

Add regression tests for stable version ordering, same-version reruns, npm package and platform tags, and invalid channel metadata. All 21 tests in `.github/scripts/test_releases.py` pass.

Retry transient gRPC code-mode session admission failures (#51185)

## Why

Transient admission errors or connection resets can prevent a code-mode session from opening before any execution starts.

## What changed

- Retry `OpenSession` and the initial lease message on `Unavailable` or `ResourceExhausted`, with at most three attempts and 100 ms and 200 ms delays within a single startup deadline.
- Classify HTTP connection and request failures as `Unavailable` so admission can recover from connection resets, while preserving error sources.
- Keep retries limited to initial admission so established executions are never replayed.

## Testing

Add gRPC integration tests covering transient status recovery, the retry limit, immediate failure for non-retryable statuses, and successful session execution after a connection reset.

Force fresh Guardian sessions for parent-checkpoint recovery (#51139)

## Why

A Guardian review restarting from the parent checkpoint must bypass cached reviewer sessions and snapshots, even when another review is using the cached session.

## What changed

- Add `ReviewerRequest::requires_fresh_session` and enable it for parent-checkpoint recovery.
- Replace an idle cached session with a fresh reusable session, or start a fresh ephemeral session when the cached session is busy. Neither recovery path inherits a cached snapshot.
- Reserve the review permit before validating a cached session and before exposing a newly spawned session to concurrent requests.

## Testing

Add tests covering recovery with idle and busy cached sessions, verifying that recovery receives no cached snapshot and that subsequent reviews reuse the appropriate session.

Recover Guardian reviews from parent checkpoints (#51137)

## Why

Reviewer compaction can invalidate previously admitted transcript evidence. When a parent checkpoint is available, restarting from that checkpoint preserves the captured parent context instead of relying on a lossy reviewer summary.

## What changed

- Restart an invalidated reviewer once from the action-time parent checkpoint, within the original review deadline.
- Preserve fresh checkpoints during startup and fit review input using the existing budget selection.
- Select transcript evidence from the checkpoint actually loaded by the reviewer. Track the transcript source so cursors remain valid across legacy-history eviction and reset when the source changes.
- Resume transcript deltas after successful recovery, including authorization added after the parent checkpoint.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for checkpoint recovery, post-checkpoint authorization, resumed deltas, and stopping after one restart. Extend history tests to cover both legacy retention and parent-checkpoint reuse, and update the checkpoint-migration snapshot.
